name: Service-Volée
text: 76,000 players indexed, hundreds of thousands of matches, ranking forecasts and a match counter.
body: Service-Volée takes the federation's public data (AFT) and makes it readable: over 76,000 player profiles indexed, over 300,000 matches, six best results, pending-points estimate and a ranking projection validated on a real case. A mobile match counter lets you umpire, share a live score and post a provisional result on the profile.
Stack: Next.js, Postgres (Neon), crawler scheduled every 10 minutes, installable PWA, account with magic link, rules chat (OpenAI).

name: Bibliopulse
text: cover scanning, a 44-million-reference ISBNdb catalogue, duplicate detection, shareable to-read pile.
body: BibliPulse lets a reader catalogue their library by scanning barcodes: each book is recognised through ISBNdb (44 million references), de-duplicated and filed. Today: 378 sign-ups, 4,800 books catalogued by 172 readers, shareable public libraries, organic growth with no advertising.
Stack: React, Supabase (auth, database, edge functions), server-side ISBNdb proxy, PWA, static pre-rendering for SEO, automated onboarding emails (Resend).

name: Beneloo Observatory
lead: the observatory of Belgian SME visibility
text: in ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity: 3 campaigns, 1,668 companies, 96 to 98% invisible.
body: The Observatory queries four AI models with frozen prompts over exhaustive samples of companies: 488 accountants in Namur, 382 plumbers in Namur, 798 accountants in Walloon Brabant. Every mention is validated by hand (correct, network brand, hallucination). Result: 96.9%, 98.4% and 96.6% invisibility; ChatGPT and Claude cite no local firm at all, Gemini hallucinates up to 52% of its answers.
Stack: Python, Postgres, immutable campaign pipeline (frozen prompts and models, capped costs), traced human validation, publishable anonymised aggregates.

name: Iris Noir Bruxelles
lead: the website of the Brussels crime-fiction fair,
text: 2026 programme at Be-Here, 39 authors, a 23-product shop, press, moved off WordPress.
body: Complete redesign of the website of the Iris Noir non-profit, the Brussels crime-fiction fair (8th edition, 30 October to 1 November 2026 at Be-Here): 39 guest authors, schedule, godmother and godfathers, literary prizes, press review, 23-product shop with cart and email ordering, contact form. Content migrated from the old WordPress through its API, classic shared hosting.
Stack: React, JSON content, lightweight PHP API (orders, contact, in-house SMTP), automated FTP deployment.

name: Royal Wellington
lead: the redesign of the Royal Wellington Club website,
text: hockey, tennis and padel since 1928, 1,600 members, 900 young players trained, in three languages.
body: Complete editorial and technical review of the Royal Wellington Club website (Brussels): 13 pages, disciplines, memberships, selections with a seasonal switch, private hire, physiotherapy, in French, Dutch and English. Content validated section by section with the club, 98 years of history, 1,600 active members, 900 young players trained.
Stack: TanStack Start, Cloudflare Workers, trilingual content, wrangler deployment.

name: Singulr
lead: my tech consulting company in the making:
text: self-hosted Forgejo, PostgreSQL, Caddy, continuous deployment.
body: Singulr SRL is my technical consulting company, currently being incorporated. The infrastructure is already live: Forgejo on forge.singulr.be, two Behostings VPS, PostgreSQL, Caddy as reverse-proxy, automated deployment.
Stack: Forgejo, PostgreSQL, Caddy, Debian VPS.

name: Wimbledon Club
lead: the website of a Belgian sports club,
text: disciplines showcase, calendar and practical information.
body: Development of the website for a Belgian sports club: disciplines overview, event calendar, practical information and contact form.
Stack: React, JSON content, Vercel deployment.

name: Pulse Noir
lead: the French-language crime and thriller community:
text: authors hub, literary prize, magazine, library of 1,900+ books.
body: Pulse Noir is the crime-fiction ecosystem I run under the PULSEMAN persona: a 2,150+ member Facebook group, pulsenoir.be with 1,900+ books and 267 referenced authors, La Revue Pulse Noir, the Grand Prix Pulse Noir (247 votes, 22 finalists, 20-reader jury) and Bibliopulse.
Stack: React, Supabase, Brevo, Lovable, Claude API, Stripe, Edge Middleware SEO.

name: Saul Racine
text: Le Cartographe des Ombres, a social noir novel being submitted to publishers.
body: Saul Racine is my pen name for French-language noir fiction. The site presents my universe, texts published on Pulse Noir's Dark Blog and my novel "On attend. On instruit. On condamne.", a social thriller set in the Belgian Masonic world.
Stack: Astro, Markdown content, Vercel deployment.

name: René Manzor
lead: the official website of filmmaker and author René Manzor:
text: filmography, books, press and an online masterclass migrated off Podia, 26 lessons, 22 videos, 71 students.
body: Official website of René Manzor, director and author: filmography, books, press area. In 2026, complete migration of his writing masterclass off Podia: 26 lessons, 22 videos with signed playback, 24 PDFs, 71 students and their comments carried over without loss, direct Stripe payment.
Stack: React, Supabase (auth, database, RLS), Cloudflare Stream, Resend, Stripe, Vercel deployment.

name: Chir-Ophta
lead: the website of a Belgian ophthalmological surgery practice,
body: Showcase website for a Belgian ophthalmological surgery practice: presentation of surgeons, covered procedures, techniques used and an appointment request form.
Stack: React, JSON content, Vercel deployment.

name: Beneloo
text: the Beneloo Score measures an SME's visibility in AI engines, and a portal tracks 17,000 prospect records.
body: Beneloo is the brand under which I support Belgian SMEs on AI visibility: diagnosis, six-pillar score, action plan, follow-up. I built the website, the observatory and the prospecting portal myself: 17,000 French-speaking company records with phone numbers, split into 11 sectors, with an AI-generated activity summary when each record is opened.
Stack: Next.js, Supabase, OpenAI and Perplexity, BCE and NBB data, email prospecting pipeline.
